subject: Update integration test script (#13)
reason: The change modifies only README.md (docs for running a single integration test) and tst/integration/run.sh (the integration test harness script: defaulting SERVER_VERSION to "unstable", a log-message tweak, and trailing newlines). Nothing in the module's compiled source (src/) changes, so the built libjson.so is byte-for-byte unaffected and no command, reply, persistence or replication behaviour differs between the two builds. A build/CI/test-script change like this cannot be reached by any runtime scenario, so none is needed.
